how children are affected by the FIFO lifestyle and the impact on family relationships.

the impact of FIFO work practices on children and family outcomes is highly complex and dependent on a range of contextual and personal factors.
the effects on children, family and relationships are dependent on a range of contextual and individual factors.
a FIFO lifestyle is not necessarily harmful or detrimental to children and families, but that it does present a range of challenges that can impact on the well-being of children and families.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is no one right way to do FIFO.
FIFO is not inherently bad or good, but it is a complex lifestyle that has the potential to impact on children and family functioning, depending on the context.
FIFO is a lifestyle choice that is not suited to everyone and it is important to be aware of potential impacts on children and families before commencing FIFO work.
The main takeaway from our work is that
FIFO workers and families are not a homogeneous group.
the FIFO lifestyle does not necessarily have negative effects on children and relationships.
there is no 'one size fits all' FIFO model.
